notes.title: Hotfix 3.0.5 is now live!
notes.content:
[h1]Fix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added slight outlining around options menu tabs to make it easier to see
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3.0 Released!
notes.content:
Patch 3.0 has been released! Scroll down to see the general hit list of changes.



[h1]Personal[/h1]
The release of Tross was not as I an anticipated. It was rough and my goal was to get it to an "okay" state, which I did. It sat for a little over a year, stagnant and always on my mind. I was not okay with the state of the game.

I decided to get back to work and make the quality of life changes to the game that I tried, and failed, to implement from the start. 

If you tried Tross in the past and could not get a handle on the preset controls, please give it another shot as keybind options have been added. 

Also, please drop a review and let me know what you think of the state of the game as it is now. I look forward to reading your comments.



[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Major [/b]
[list]
[*] Controller support has returned!
[*] Keybinding options added
[*] New Main, Options, and Pause menus and settings
[*] Sector 13 has been completely redone
[/list]

[b]Minor[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated VFX throughout the game
[*] New death effect has been added as the previous one was terrible
[*] Ending the level is made less boring with a little video
[*] Various bug fixes that I lost track of
[/list]



[h1]TLDR[/h1]
Updated Tross since I was unhappy with it. Give it a whirl and toss a review to let me know what you think!

notes.title: Patch 2.5 is Live!
notes.content:
Tross Patch 2.5 contains several bug fixes, enhancements, and optimizations.

 [h1] Key Additions [/h1]

- Keybinds Menu (Players are now able to edit keybinds within the Options menu)

- Monitor based resolution support



 [h1] Key Enhancements [/h1]

- Made the pillars in Sector 1 wider for ease of use

- Edited Sector 4 to make the course easier


 [h1] Fixes [/h1]

 - Various minor fixes

 [h1] Removal of Gamepad support [/h1]
Unfortunately, Gamepad support has been officially removed with Patch 2.5. Tross was designed and built with keyboard/mouse controls in mind. Each Sector proved to be immensely difficult to complete using the Gamepad. I made the decision to remove official support in order to bring consistency and a clear vision back to Tross.

I do realize that this will alienate some players but I feel that pulling Gamepad support is better than the feeling of awkward gameplay.

notes.title: Patch 2.0 is Live!
notes.content:
Tross 2.0 contains a major gameplay improvement among other various bug fixes and optimizations.

Users are now equipped, by default, with 2 "shields" that will absorb a collision impact. The shield will absorb up to 2 collisions per Sector prior to User death.

This feature may be disabled for those who dare to enter the true form of the Tross by activating "Hard Mode" within the Gameplay Options menu.


[h1]Additions:[/h1]

- A "shield" that will absorb up to 2 collisions per Sector.

- "Hard Mode" for those who wish to enter the true form of the Tross.

- "Hard Mode" achievements. 
[i] If you have previously obtained achievements they will be converted to "Hard Mode." [/i]

- Patch 2.0 information screen. This will only appear once.


[h1]Fixes:[/h1]

- Sector 4 optimizations

- One-way Cube has appropriate collision

- Various minor fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.05 is Live!
notes.content:
Patch 1.05 contains various bug fixes in addition to a few user experience enhancements.

[h1]Additions:[/h1]

-“Normal” control set option
-Initial controls selection process 
-Small sound effect for story text 
-Controller and Keyboard/Mouse controls can be used simultaneously 

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]

-All settings should now persist through death
-Resolution now defaults to 1920x1080 Fullscreen on startup (unless the resolution was changed previously)
-Pausing is now possible using a controller (Start or View buttons based on controller)
-Various menu and setting tweaks
-Various minor code fixes

[h1]Removed:[/h1]

-“Controller Enabled” option
-Old controls images



*Note: If you see BuildID 995264 under the Local Files menu then the patch build is NOT installed. Select "Verify Integrity of Game Cache" to force the download. The 1.05 patch build is BuildID 999814.*

notes.title: Additional Control Options Patch...
notes.content:
Additional control options are in the works as I speak. The default set of controls were based on player feedback.

Naturally when a game is released to the public, a much larger sample size, additional feedback and preferences will pour in.

I have gathered this feedback and will be adding additional controls imminently. 

Stay tuned!
